title: Analysis code for "Contact-dependent intercellular dTMP transfer sustains tumor cell proliferation"
description: Analysis code for the five bioinformatics Methods sections of Contact-dependent intercellular dTMP transfer sustains tumor cell proliferation: human A549 bulk RNA-seq differential expression analysis (GSE271721), single-cell classification analysis (GSE148071), Visium spatial neighborhood analysis (10x Genomics Human Lung Cancer, FFPE), spatial deconvolution and cell-state co-abundance analysis using cell2location and NMF (spatial data: E-MTAB-13530; single-cell reference: E-MTAB-13526), and Kras/Trp53 amplicon gene-editing and mutation analysis. Each analysis folder records inputs, provenance and execution limits. MIT applies to laboratory-authored code; third-party code and scientific data retain their original terms.
